title: retainkit: context and memory policies for LLM agents, scored by the evidence that survives the token budget
description: Context and memory policies for LLM agents, scored by the evidence that survives the token budget — across 1,527 LoCoMo questions a sliding window holds 7.7% of the supporting turns at 2,048 tokens, where retrieval holds 59.5% and a window needs 16 times the budget to match it.
